tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Chalk on light (the colour of a chalked bar); Iron Black on dark. Dark is the default in-app theme, because the phone sits on a bench in a dim gym.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and panels on ground. Separate them with a line hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and graph gridlines. Decorative only: never the sole cue for something a person must see.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, chart axes, unselected toggles, in-range rep bars. At least 3.2:1 on ground and ground-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and headings on ground and ground-raised (at least 13:1 in both themes). Iron Black on light, Chalk on dark. Also the secondary button fill, with ground-coloured text on it, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, captions, timestamps, inactive labels. At least 6:1 on ground and ground-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Plate Red, the brand's one colour and the only colour that carries meaning: the logo's bar, the fault marker, and the fill of the one primary button. The same red in both themes. Put on-signal text on it. On light it passes as text too (4.8:1 on ground). On dark it's 3.1:1 on ground, enough for fills and shapes but not text; on ground-raised it's 2.9:1, so a red shape there gets a signal-ink edge. Red text on dark uses signal-ink.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Red as text, thin strokes and small marks that carry meaning: 'Knees caving', fault readings, rep numbers, the edge of a fault shape. The same as signal on light (4.8:1 on ground); a lighter matched red on dark (5.3:1 on ground, 4.9:1 on ground-raised), because Plate Red is too dark to read as text on Iron Black.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill: Chalk in both themes (4.8:1). Never Iron Black on red.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: hero lines and the tagline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: FormGuard learns how you move during your warm-up set, then checks every rep after it against that.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Joint names, tags, overlines. Set it in uppercase.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: The measured value: joint angle, depth, rep count. Treat it like a gauge reading.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Small figures in tables, charts and rep logs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a reading and its unit, or an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control and between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the default gap between elements.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between sections and the page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, chart bars. Machined, not soft.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots only, echoing the logo's round red bar: the joint marker and the Flag marker.
